There is no reimplemented protocol client a"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"nd no second copy of the MCP SDK: the plugin is a *carrier bundle*, and everything you can do comes "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"from the official bridge."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What it gives the agent"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"With the plugin installed and Windows-MCP reachable, these tools appear in the tool list:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `mcp__windows__Screenshot` | Capture the screen; the image lands in the conversation as a real att"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"achment |
| `mcp__windows__Snapshot` | Capture an accessibility tree (text, no image tokens) |
| `mc"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"p__windows__DisplayInventory` | Enumerate displays and their geometry |
| `mcp__windows__Click` / `M"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ove` / `Scroll` | Mouse input |
| `mcp__windows__Type` / `Shortcut` | Keyboard input |
| `mcp__windo"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ws__Wait` / `WaitFor` | Sleep, or wait until a UI condition holds |
| `mcp__windows__Scrape` | Extra"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ct text from a window |
| `mcp__windows__MultiSelect` / `MultiEdit` | Batch element selection / batc"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"h edits |
| `mcp__windows__Clipboard` | Read and write the clipboard |
| `mcp__windows__Process` | L"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ist, start and stop processes |
| `mcp__windows__Notification` | Read notifications |
| `mcp__window"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"s__Registry` | Read and write registry values |
| `mcp__windows__ControlStatus` | Control-loop state"},{"id":"p10s10","text":". **Cannot be disabled** — upstream force-keeps it |
| `mcp__windows__App` | Launch/switch apps. *Ex"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"cluded by default* (upstream only supports it reliably on an English Windows install) |
| `mcp__wind"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ows__PowerShell` / `FileSystem` | *Excluded by default* — DSH already ships shell and file tools |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Plus one tool of its own, `windows_mcp_doctor`, which explains what is wrong when the `mcp__windows_"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"_*` tools are missing."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The composer also gains a **Computer Use** pill, next to the permission control: it shows how many d"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"esktop tools are actually registered and remembers your choice across restarts (state file: `~/.dsh/"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"dsh-windows-mcp.state.json`). It starts **off** — a fresh install never hands the agent your desktop"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" until you switch the pill on yourself."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Windows 10/11.**

- **uv** on the `PATH` of the process that runs DSH — **Settings → Deskt"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"op** uses it to install Windows-MCP. DSH itself boots without it. `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin` is sear"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ched even when it is not on `PATH`.

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"This plugin hands the model your mouse, your keyboard, your clipboard, your
processes and your regis"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"try. Treat installing it as handing over control of the
desktop session it runs in."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"What the design does and does not do:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **No network exposure by default.** The default row is stdio: a child process
connected by pipes, "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"not a listening socket.
- **Secret hygiene on the child process.** The bridge starts MCP children fr"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"om a
scrubbed environment: variable names matching `KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN` and
**all** `DSH_*` v"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ariables are removed before the configured `env` is merged in.
Credentials should therefore be passe"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"d explicitly through the row's `env`, not
inherited.
- **No telemetry from this plugin.** Upstream's"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" own PostHog reporting is
explicitly disabled in the shipped defaults.
- **Remote serving is upstrea"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"m's problem, not a hidden default.** If you switch
to HTTP, upstream enforces loopback host filterin"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"g and refuses to start on a
non-loopback address without an auth key.
- **Switch flips are a window "},{"id":"p21s9","text":"decision, not a network one.** Every mutating
route (`/state`, `/prepare`, `/prepare/cancel`, `/brid"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"ge`, `/update`,
`/settings`) requires the signed session cookie the DSH window receives during
the l"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"aunch-token exchange; without it the request is refused with `401`. A
script, `curl`, or a model wit"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"h shell access cannot turn desktop control on for
itself. Reads stay open so pages can render before"},{"id":"p21s13","text":" anything is decided.
- **When the cookie cannot be checked, the plugin says so.** A composition tha"},{"id":"p21s14","text":"t
mounts no `connection` service (headless hosts, Electron `file://`) cannot be
authenticated; `/sta"},{"id":"p21s15","text":"te` then reports `"gate": {"cookie": "unobservable"}`. In
that case do not expose the web server on "},{"id":"p21s16","text":"a non-loopback `--host`.
- **Files are still files.** The Computer Use flag in
`$DSH_HOME/dsh-window"},{"id":"p21s17","text":"s-mcp.state.json` and the machine-written patch block are
ordinary files owned by the same user. An "},{"id":"p21s18","text":"agent that can write them can still
change the plugin's behaviour across a restart — the cookie gate"},{"id":"p21s19","text":" closes the
HTTP path, not filesystem trust. If that matters to you, run the desktop on a
